payout_quote: Terms and Conditions: Arbor Financial Credit Union Refer-a-Friend Program. Friend must be (i) a legal resident of the United States of America, (ii) at least 18 years old, (iii) be eligible for membership in the Credit Union, (iv) opened a primary savings account with the minimum opening balance requirement of five ($5) dollars, (v) not be a current member of the Credit Union at the time of application, (vi) open a Credit Union Checking Account, (vii) direct deposit to the new Checking Account an aggregate total of five hundred ($500) dollars within 60 days, with a minimum of two direct deposits, (viii) and perform ten (10) debit card Point-of-Sale transactions within 60 days. Residents of California are not eligible to be Referrers or Friends. Maximum of nineteen (19) referrals per Referrer may earn Rewards. You can earn a maximum of one thousand nine hundred ($1,900) dollars in combined Rewards per year. By making a qualifying and validated referral, Referrer will receive a one hundred ($100) dollar deposit to their primary savings account. Friend will also receive a ($100) dollar deposit to their checking account. The Reward will be paid to a qualified Referrer or Friend after the 60-day qualification period following the Credit Union verification of compliance. Rewards may take up to two weeks for posting. Rewards may not be redeemed for cash. You are responsible for all applicable federal, state and local taxes that may apply to the Reward. If applicable, the value of your reward may be reported to the IRS on a 1099-MISC for the Referrer or Friend. These Terms are effective as of February 13, 2026.
steps: Get a referral from an existing Arbor Financial CU member in good standing (US resident, 18+; must use the referrer Personal Link).

Qualify for Arbor FCU membership and open a primary savings account with the $5 minimum opening balance (retained membership share deposit, not a fee), plus a new Credit Union Checking Account. You must not be a current member at the time of application.
Within 60 days: direct deposit an aggregate total of $500 to the new checking account (minimum two direct deposits) and perform ten (10) debit card point-of-sale transactions.
The $100 Friend reward is deposited to the checking account after the 60-day qualification period plus verification (rewards may take up to two weeks for posting).
catches: Requires a referral from an existing member in good standing via their Personal Link - you cannot earn it by walking in cold; bulk/spam distribution of referrals is prohibited and can void rewards.

Heavier than it first looks: the Friend must (1) open a $5 primary savings share, (2) direct deposit $500+ in aggregate within 60 days (at least two deposits), and (3) make 10 debit card POS purchases within 60 days.
Residents of California are NOT eligible to be Referrers or Friends - official exclusion.
Reward paid only after the 60-day qualification period plus verification; rewards may take up to two additional weeks for posting.
Referred member must be a US resident, 18+, eligible for and approved for membership, and not a current member at application time.
Rewards may not be redeemed for cash, are not transferable, and can be delayed or refused for investigation.
Reward may be reported on 1099-MISC as taxable income.
Referrer capped at 19 rewarded referrals / $1,900 per year total.
Terms effective February 13, 2026; the Credit Union may cancel, modify, or terminate the program at any time without notice.
biggest_catch: You need an existing member to refer you (no cold walk-ins), California residents are excluded, and the Friend must complete $500 in direct deposits plus 10 debit POS purchases within 60 days - the $100 pays only after the 60-day qualification period plus verification.
eligibility: New members referred by an existing Arbor Financial CU member in good standing via the Personal Link; Friend must be a US resident, 18+, eligible for membership, not a current member, open a $5 primary savings share and a new checking account; California residents excluded.
timing: Reward paid after the 60-day qualification period following verification of both parties compliance; rewards may take up to two weeks for posting.

The qualification period is a fixed calendar window — finishing the required transactions early does NOT pay the bonus sooner; the bank calculates the bonus only after the period closes. Fastest honest path: complete the required transactions in the first week so you can't forget them, then wait out the period with the account open and in good standing.
